claims.statement: Auto-add guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; GHES project automation additionally requires enterprise-owner policy enablement. Source does not establish actual target permissions or accessible repository set.

Auto-add adds matching items on creation or update, not immediately existing matching items on activation. This differs from auto-archive historical backfill; newly enabled workflow alone cannot certify existing corpus coverage.

Supported qualifiers are is(open/closed/merged/draft/issue/pr), label, reason(completed/reopened/not planned), assignee and no(label/assignee/reason). Other search qualifiers must not be assumed supported.
All filters except no support negation; -label:bug is illustrative. Negated no is not documented supported; actual matching and combined-filter behavior require independent test evidence.

projects-v2-duplicate-auto-add feature resolves FPT/GHEC only at pinned commit. Multiple-workflow and duplication sections are absent for GHES despite GHES row in the conditional plan table; preserve unreachable table row rather than infer GHES multiple-workflow availability.
Conditional plan limits are Free user 1, Pro 5, Team 5, GHEC 20, with GHES 20 listed inside cloud-only feature. These are historical reference limits, not current entitlement or cost approval.

Workflow edit selects repository and filter, then Save and turn on workflow. Saving/enabling changes automation and is not proof of successful item ingestion, correct permission handling or absence of unintended imports.

Cloud-conditional duplicates can target different repositories or same repository with unique filters, up to plan cap. Duplicate name/save does not prove enabled workflow, unique effective matching or deduplicated project membership.
Further-reading links do not certify complete project automation review. No project workflow enabled or duplicated, items imported, rights cleared, controls accepted or native rollout executed.
